desc_lfm_album: Released on June 24th, 1989, Start Today is the debut studio album by straight edge, new york hardcore band Gorilla Biscuits. Released under the indie label Revelation Records, it's one of their biggest-selling records ever, with over 100,000 units sold. Straight edge began to root outside of its D.C. origins; its influence entered into the New York hardcore scene. Between the mid-80s, a new movement rose within the New York hardcore scene called youth crew, a movement described as having incorporated straight edge themes as well as having a positive lyricism and messaging like communal unity, everyday struggles of the .
desc_lfm_artist: Gorilla Biscuits is a New York straight edge hardcore punk band on Revelation Records. They formed in 1987. They picked the name under pressure to have a name when Token Entry got them a stage appearance unexpectedly. Ironically (due to their straight edge status), the name came from a big quaalude known as a "gorilla biscuit" which was popular in their neighborhood.
